review.gallery: Nine native project renders from the developer-authored Milan Heights brochure, obtained via Azizi.cz. The lead shows the complete Heights tower group. Generic people and lifestyle photos were excluded.
review.location: The master-community map in the same brochure and the separately mirrored Milan Heights factsheet corroborate the City of Arabia site and road access. Neither verifies a Milan Heights entrance or a timed route.
review.floorPlans: All eight labelled sample types on physical pages 38–41 and the separate Heights site diagram on page 7. Both three-bedroom labels remain available. The total and suite figures conflict with the extent shown for the balcony. The parent Milan and separate Tower F figures were kept out of the Heights sample sheets.

unavailable: Exact entry coordinates, confirmed travel times, individual retail and amenity floor plans, and a final area schedule for every tower were not established.
